emerging_technology: Large language models (generative AI for text)
intended_application: Ambient clinical documentation: drafting visit notes from recorded doctor-patient conversations for physician review
organization: Regional nonprofit hospital system (4 hospitals, ~600 physicians)
business_need: Physician burnout and after-hours charting time; documentation backlog affecting patient throughput
users_stakeholders: Physicians, nurses, patients, compliance office, health IT, medical records, payers
capabilities_constraints: Small IT team; Epic EHR; no in-house ML staff; strict vendor security review; limited capital budget
risk_consequence_context: High: note errors can affect clinical care and billing; patient privacy exposure; physician sign-off required on every note
management_question: Should the system run a limited pilot of an LLM documentation tool in one outpatient department?
time_horizon: Pilot decision in the next 3 months; evaluation over 12 months
